target.title: fix(vercel-ai-gateway): discover models when HTTP proxy is required
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users whose outbound HTTPS access requires an HTTP(S) proxy would wait through the Vercel AI Gateway discovery timeout and then see only the 4 static fallback models in `openclaw models list --provider vercel-ai-gateway --plain`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fixed Vercel AI Gateway official catalog request now uses the existing trusted environment-proxy guarded-fetch preset. The existing SSRF hostname policy, timeout, cache, response release, direct/`NO_PROXY` behavior, and static fallback remain unchanged.

## User Impact

OpenClaw can now discover the live Vercel AI Gateway model catalog in proxy-required environments instead of silently falling back to the small static catalog.

## Evidence

- TDD red: the regression test failed against the original production call because the guarded request did not select `mode: "trusted_env_proxy"` (1 failed, 8 passed).
- Focused green: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/vercel-ai-gateway/provider-catalog.test.ts` — 1 file, 9 tests passed.
- Extension lane: `pnpm test:extension vercel-ai-gateway` — 3 files, 14 tests passed.
- Repository gate: `pnpm check:changed` passed, including formatting, production/test types, lint, plugin boundaries, API baseline, and import-cycle checks.
- Live before (Linux, Node 24.15.0, isolated test state, required HTTPS proxy): `pnpm openclaw models list --provider vercel-ai-gateway --plain` timed out after 5 seconds and listed only the 4 static fallback models.
- Third-party control: Vercel's official `https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models` endpoint returned HTTP 200 with 302 models through the same proxy route.
- Live after (same OpenClaw command and environment, final code): OpenClaw listed 302 Vercel AI Gateway models, matching the official third-party response.
- No-proxy control: after clearing all HTTP(S)/ALL proxy variables, OpenClaw still timed out safely and returned the same 4 static fallback models.
- `codex review --base origin/main`: no actionable findings.
